hypothesis: A persistent tool-query program derived from source training feedback can improve observations elicited from CURRENT images and downstream answers beyond a source-free fixed query using the same tool, images and call count. Native unchanged H0 remains the primary reference.
motivation: v12 source experience changed no initial answers during review; test acquisition of new current-case tool observations rather than further passive review. Existing B is the previously defined metadata-based multi-image comparison task, not an invented clinical shift.

selection.training: Original24 v9B training cases and their H0_train attempts plus unadjudicated benchmark feedback; all sources retained. Only source text/feedback sent to the one program proposal, no target questions or outcomes.
selection.development: Six exposed v7B report cases: first3 H0 errors then first3 H0-correct cases in original v7 input order. Explicitly outcome-enriched adaptive reuse; target selection never uses v11/v12 predictions.
selection.separation: Source/target case IDs and known canonical image paths disjoint; not a claim of patient-independent evaluation.

policy.schema: admit,tool_name,query_template,source_indices,rationale; tool restricted to chest_xray_expert or llava_med_qa, one literal question_stem placeholder,250-1600chars,>=4 distinct source indices0-23. No generated code execution.
policy.source_supervision: Benchmark feedback is not clinical adjudication; propose observable-fact elicitation, never assert source diagnoses as medical rules.
policy.persistent_state: One source-derived query program frozen before evaluation. Fixed control uses SAME selected tool and independently frozen source-free query. No target feedback updates either state.
policy.decline_or_invalid: Preserve original one proposal and costs, perform no target evaluation; report eligibility/format failure rather than a clinical negative result.

execution.current_fact_prefix: For each target image, execute exactly one actual selected native-tool invocation in fixed and learned arms. Use the same tool across these two arms. Both queries receive the same current question stem without answer options; only the persistent query procedure differs. Standard tool defaults preserved.
execution.controller: Original author native prompt/current images/six tools/two-turn final-letter scoring. H0 gets no prefix. Other arms receive the same wrapper and image-indexed raw tool observations, not explicit program/query/rationale/source records. Tool outputs may echo their input and remain fallible; no expert observation oracle is claimed.
execution.bounds: One prefix call per current image; prefix calls count toward the same16-tool budget. Further native tool calls allowed under unchanged total limits. Observation text capped12000chars per image identically for both prefix arms, full native tool logs private.
execution.order: Casewise3-arm rotation; second block reverse target order and shift rotation by1; new Agent/MemorySaver every physical episode, no aliases.
execution.scoring: Read gold only after all predictions or termination; full planned denominators, exact final A-F.
execution.model: Existing local subscription gpt-6.1-sol/high; all medical tools/weights unchanged; no new credentials,API provider or paid resource.

gate.requirements: All36 valid and admitted program. BOTH repeats learned vsH0 net>=2/6 with H0 loss<=1; learned vsfixed net>=1/6; >=2 cases repeated H0 wrong/learned correct AND learned actual controller observation-prefix text differs from fixed in each repeat.
gate.interpretation: Necessary non-identical intervention check, not proof that text differences are medically correct or causal. Solely error-enriched exploratory benchmark evidence, no general clinical accuracy, full-HCL or A-to-B retention claim.
gate.fail: Close fixed policy/variant; no proposal regeneration, target/source resampling, prompt/threshold changes or selective reruns inside experiment.
gate.statistics: All paired gain/loss tables, descriptive exact McNemar, tool-query/evidence coverage, identical-observation nominal gains, per-arm inference/tool/token/rate-limit/runtime costs; repetitions do not increase independent N.

limits.hard_deadline: min(original local implementation/preparation start+6h,windowdeadline); do not reset

limitations: Training supervision and tool observations not independently medically adjudicated; this is not Pro E1 or an O-oracle.
Six reused, error-enriched targets from existing B group; single frozen source bank/proposal, adaptive development.
Fixed/learned tool choice matched but query lengths not exactly token matched; H0 has fewer mandatory tool calls.
Raw tool text can contain ungrounded interpretations, artifacts or echoes; completed does not imply factual correctness.
Current images only, no historical-patient images sent to tools; no doctor resource fabricated.
public_boundary: Only code,protocol,aggregate,audit,cost; no question/image/label/program content/case identifier/per-case trace/credential.
